title: CTIA Wireless Spotlight: Talking with Mariam Sorond
summary: NextNav CEO and CTIA Board Member Mariam Sorond joined CTIA’s Wireless Spotlight to discuss why America needs a resilient, ground-based complement and backup to GPS and what’s at stake without one.
body_markdown:
GPS powers nearly every aspect of modern life, but relying on a single system leaves our nation vulnerable.


NextNav CEO and CTIA Board Member Mariam Sorond joined CTIA’s Wireless Spotlight to discuss why America needs a resilient, ground-based complement and backup to GPS and what’s at stake without one.


Watch her full interview below and learn more on[CTIA.org](https://www.ctia.org/news/wireless-spotlight-talking-with-mariam-sorond-board-chair-ceo-nextnav) .
